simulator.whyEnglishText: Foundational models (Claude 3.7/Sonnet, OpenAI o-series/GPT-4o, Gemini 2.5/Pro, DeepSeek R1/V3) have over 85% of their training corpus and reasoning benchmarks in English. about.heading: # about
about.title: Web engineering
about.bio: I'm Brahyan Belalcázar, a Full-Stack developer with over 10 years shipping production software across sectors with distinct business models: industrial mining and electricity (Tripro), tax and legal advisory (Restrepo y Londoño), B2B and B2C e-commerce (Siesa Ecommerce), ERP and interactive signage (LogicalSoft), and publishing (Los Tres Editores). Each sector taught me unique architectures, operational constraints, and engineering techniques — enabling me to take complex features to full production functionality. My core stack centers on JavaScript and PHP, mastered at a senior level over the years: from custom WordPress plugin architecture and REST APIs to complete Node.js applications. Today, I combine that track record with AI-assisted engineering to accelerate iteration speed without sacrificing code quality.
about.philosophy: I believe in closing the loop: every feature undergoes simulation, implementation, review, and rigorous testing — always under human engineering control. The open-source code I publish (semantic memory cores, P2P mesh protocols, multi-agent orchestration) serves as my laboratory to validate these techniques:
about.philosophyAccent: iterate fast, verify always, ship to production.

xavier2.name: Xavier
xavier2.description: Persistent local cognitive memory core for AI agents built in Rust. Containerized Docker microservice providing vector storage, HNSW semantic search index, and unified knowledge graphs.
xavier2.architecture: Native Rust engine with SQLite-vec and pgvector. Cosine similarity vector search with local embeddings without external cloud dependency. High-speed REST and RPC APIs.
metrics: Unified integration with Hermes and Gestalt

gitcore.name: GitCore
gitcore.description: Operational harness and deterministic orchestrator for autonomous coding agents (Jules, Claude Code, OpenCode). Automates issue creation with formal specs, micro-fragmentation batches of up to 15 parallel tasks, and collision-free PR validation.
gitcore.architecture: Decoupled architecture in Rust and CLI automation scripts. Disjoint file islands system to prevent merge conflicts during massive parallel executions.

timeline.label: Initial issue protocol and agent traceability
Wave Operations: micro-fragmentation and 15 micro-task batches
Integration with Hermes Gateway and pre-delegation auditing
Roadmap: Multi-repository P2P distributed swarm

gestalt.name: Gestalt
gestalt.description: Autonomous swarm orchestrator and multi-role agent CLI routing in Rust. Uses SurrealDB for state persistence, role-based task routing, and custom inter-agent communication protocols.
gestalt.architecture: Native Rust CLI with Tokio async integration. Graph and state persistence in SurrealDB. Deterministic sandboxes for testing LLM-generated code.

timeline.label: Prototype and state schema in SurrealDB
Multi-agent coordination layer and dynamic execution from CLI
Continuous loop integration with Xavier memory
Roadmap: Decentralized swarm intelligence

photon-core.name: Photon-Core
photon-core.description: Authored university research and intellectual property serving as scientific foundation and roadmap for SouthWest AI Labs to experiment with future ultra-dense volumetric storage capabilities. Proof of concept (PoC) and simulation software in Rust modeling optical physics of femtosecond laser pulses in fused silica, Reed-Solomon ECC, birefringence, and 3D crosstalk mitigation.
photon-core.architecture: Deterministic Rust simulator modeling physical interaction between light and fused silica glass: optical slow-axis delay and optical axis orientation as 2 additional dimensions to spatial axes (X,Y,Z). Includes Rayon parallelism evaluating theoretical encoding rates >470 MB/s and interleaved Reed-Solomon ECC.
metrics: Mathematical simulation & PoC software authored by myself
3D spatial crosstalk tolerance >30% with Reed-Solomon ECC
Research foundation for SWAL's physical roadmap
